Mighty patches are the best product I have found for absorbing pimples. They work great every time, and the big patches can be cut to different shapes and sizes for different problem areas.

I have always struggled with acne on my face and love the original patches, so I decided to give these a try for the larger areas I get breakouts in like my cheeks and chin. If I could go back in time and not use these patches I would in a heartbeat. When I put the patches on I have high hopes. However when I went to remove the patch it was extremely hard to peel off. I could almost feel it peeling the top layer of skin off. When I did get it off my face had a sticky residue left on it which was then hard to wash off. I followed my same routine I always do before applying: washing my face, toner, then patches once the toner dries. Once I was able to get all the sticky residue off my face it was very red. Over the next couple days the preexisting breakouts I had got worse and painful on top of numerous new breakouts in the areas I put the patches. Would not recommend these at all especially if you're trying to improve your skin.

I get cystic hormonal acne and it often comes in clusters. These patches help me avoid picking and create a barrier between my breakout and environmental toxins. They are designed to suck the gunk out of breakouts that have formed a head and are ready to pop, so they wont do much for deep breakouts that havent come to the surface yet. They do speed up the healing process for me. I find that my skin regenerates quicker after a cystic breakout when I use these vs when I dont. They stick well overnight and during the day. I cut the patches up to fit the concentrated areas and that allows me to get a ton of uses out of one package making the price worth it imo.

I tend to have a cluster of pimples specifically white heads that I rather not squeeze out. so instead of using a bunch of individual pimple patches I figured I'd try to to cover more surfaces. avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Great product! I love hero!!! These patches are amazing when I get big concentrated areas of acne. Usually does really well getting every pimple that it is ready. There's so white the basically can be whipped of my face and it is my biggest pet peeve when that happens. I've learned I cannot use any product whatsoever under the patch.

avis.titre: Best acne product in the market
avis.texte: I have used these on my face for blemishes and on my body for ingrown hairs and blemishes!! It absolutely saved me from a boil I had forming on my inner thigh I used this overnight and after one night it was halfway down and out of pain. And after the next night it was gone!!! Some people say the skin wrinkles or feels weird after but just remember it's drawing out all the infection and sebaceous fluid under the skin. So it is damp under the patch. The small ones work just as effectively!

avis.titre: Did Not Work/Gave Me Temporary Wrinkles
avis.texte: I get a lot of whiteheads on my chin so I thought this would be a good way to clear out the congestion and gunk. I applied two strips to my chin to cover all the whiteheads. I made sure to apply the strips to clean, dry skin as it instructs on the package. I went to bed excited to rip them off in the morning and see all the gunk. However, when I removed the strips I only saw one tiny spot on one of the strips where it got some stuff out, and when I looked at my chin I could tell no difference - I could still see tons of little clogged pores. Worst of all, one of the strips wasn't laying completely smooth on my skin (it got a bit wrinkled/bunched up since it was on an area that's not completely flat) and when I took it off, there were these weird lines on my skin, like deep wrinkles. The area was also super red and irritated. I put some moisturizer on that area to help hopefully soothe and smooth the skin back out. The whole experience was very disappointing for me, since the strips did not remove my whiteheads and actually left some indentations on my skin (that will hopefully go away soon, but still upsetting). If you use these, I highly suggest making sure the strips are completely flat/smooth and there are no wrinkles in them.
I would highly recommend this, especially if someone's problem/ breakout area is there chin like me
At first I was very skeptical. I don't have many breakdouts but when I do it takes forever. These are super fast. The whole line is pretty awesome.

avis.titre: Work very well on white heads

I have problems with cystic acne and I've definitely had clusters on my cheeks. These patches work great for those large areas. Like with any patch, make sure that most of the acne pimples have formed whiteheads, or else the pus won't actually come out and be on the patch. I also have cut the patches up and used customized sizes on some areas. It sticks really well too. I took off one star, because unless you do have whiteheads that are ready to pop, sometimes it only just picks up dry skin. It also can be so sticky that taking it off kind of feels like ripping a strong bandaid off.

I use the dots for foot treating and once a week do an overnight in the large ones over areas I'm prone to breaking out. Love these, and will keep purchasing.

Usually hydrocolloid patches don't work for my deeper hormonal zits. For some reason, without fail, these do. And they're big enough that they can really clear up a big area. I've bought them twice now and will continue buying them

what kind of sorcery?!!! the absolute best patch i've ever tried! i've tried so many & have only ever loved one but its hardly in stock so i tried this and omg! the nose strips are way too big on my small nose so i cut them in half & use them like these and it still works. AMAZING

This worked great for me! I used it on my chin which has been breaking out a ton lately. It pulled out so much overnight and my chin was clear then next morning. Can't wait to try this on other areas as well!

Also really helpful healing pimples that have bled -- they have time to heal (and more quickly!) under the patch. Which is KEY to helping "mascne" since it prevents further contamination and irritation from mask/dirties my mask.
